title: onggi.verification.v1
description: Result of apply or rollback (ADR-0010): what the device holds now, with a digest per written unit in artifact byte space, so the caller can check it against the artifact.

manifest.description: the artifact resident after the operation

ok.description: true only when every unit verified; when false the binding has restored the base or unloaded the model

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the unit as read back from the device, in artifact byte order
